metadata.title: Privacy Policy | YolPol
metadata.description: Learn how YolPol handles website, contact, Inquiry and security information.

PrivacyPage.heading: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.introduction: This policy explains how YolPol handles information when you browse this website, contact us, prepare an Inquiry, or use secure online Inquiry submission after it is enabled.

controller.heading: Data controller and contact
controller.text: YolPol is the public operator responsible for the processing described in this policy.

information.heading: Information we handle
information.introduction: The information involved depends on how you use the website.

provided.contact: Full name, optional company name, email, phone or WhatsApp number, and preferred contact method.
provided.location: Your country and city, and the destination country and city when provided.
provided.request: Selected Product IDs, requested quantities and units, and an optional customer message.
provided.context: Active locale, source page or path, consent status and acceptance timestamp, and Inquiry creation or update timestamps after submission is enabled.

information.securityText: After secure submission is enabled, limited metadata may include a truncated or one-way hashed IP address, User-Agent, submission timestamp, and rate-limit or abuse-prevention metadata.
information.preferenceText: An essential language preference, such as the NEXT_LOCALE cookie, may remember your selected locale.

paragraphs.local: The website currently lets you prepare an Inquiry locally. Secure online submission is not active, and the current form does not persist or send personal information to YolPol.
paragraphs.contact: You may instead contact YolPol through the published Email or WhatsApp destinations. The form does not place your entered values into those links.
paragraphs.providers: Personal information sent through Email or WhatsApp is also handled under the relevant provider's own privacy practices.

items.response: Respond to Product and quotation inquiries.
items.products: Understand requested Products, quantities, shipment destinations, and commercial requirements.
items.security: Prevent spam, fraud, and abuse and maintain service security.
items.legal: Comply with valid legal obligations when applicable.

paragraphs.inquiries: After real submission is enabled, Inquiry records may be retained for up to 24 months and may be deleted earlier when no longer required.
paragraphs.security: Limited security metadata may be retained for up to 30 days.
paragraphs.legal: Information required by a valid legal obligation may need a different retention period where applicable.
paragraphs.current: Forms currently prepared locally are not stored by YolPol.

paragraphs.planned: When submission infrastructure is enabled, YolPol may truncate or one-way hash an IP address and process User-Agent, submission timestamps, and rate-limit or abuse-prevention metadata.
paragraphs.notAnonymous: Hashing does not necessarily make an IP address anonymous.
paragraphs.purpose: This metadata would be used only for rate limiting, spam prevention, abuse prevention, and security investigation, not advertising, and would be retained for no more than 30 days.

paragraphs.sale: YolPol does not intend to sell Inquiry information.
paragraphs.providers: Information may be processed by infrastructure or communication providers only when required to operate the service. Future providers may include hosting, database, Email, Telegram, or automation services after they are configured; none is currently connected to this Inquiry form.
paragraphs.updates: This policy will be updated when material providers or processing behavior changes.
paragraphs.direct: Direct communication through WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, LinkedIn, or Email involves independent third-party platforms under their own terms and privacy practices.

international.heading: International processing
international.text: YolPol serves international customers and may use providers in different countries. After relevant infrastructure is enabled, information may therefore be processed outside your country.

paragraphs.locale: Essential language-preference storage, including a NEXT_LOCALE cookie, may be used to remember the selected locale.
paragraphs.advertising: No advertising cookie is currently intentionally used.
paragraphs.analytics: Google Analytics and Umami are not installed or active.
paragraphs.storage: No Inquiry personal data is stored in localStorage or sessionStorage.

paragraphs.current: No website analytics platform is currently active, and Google Analytics is not active.
paragraphs.future: Self-hosted Umami is the preferred future traffic analytics option.
paragraphs.update: This policy will be reviewed and updated before analytics is activated. Any required consent mechanism will be implemented before analytics that requires consent is loaded.

searchVisibility.heading: Search visibility
searchVisibility.text: Google Search Console verification is not currently implemented. A future search-performance tool may provide aggregated information about how pages appear in search results; it is distinct from visitor analytics.

choices.heading: Your choices and requests
choices.textAfterEmail: with questions or, subject to applicable requirements, to request:

items.deletion: Deletion where the information is no longer required or another applicable reason exists.
items.withdrawal: Withdrawal of consent for future processing.

children.heading: Children
children.text: YolPol's commercial glass-bottle services are not directed to children.

externalLinks.heading: External links
externalLinks.text: This website may link to external services. YolPol does not control or take responsibility for their independent privacy practices.

changes.heading: Policy changes
changes.text: This policy may be updated when processing changes, including when:

items.providers: Service providers or processing behavior changes.
